description: This PHP script handles the installation and upgrade process for the TestLink application database, including creating connections, verifying inputs, creating or upgrading database schemas, inserting default data, creating users, and writing configuration files. It also includes HTML for user feedback and instructions.

classes.name: database
classes.description: A class responsible for database connectivity, executing queries, and managing database operations.

classes.name: SqlParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and processing SQL files related to database schema and data setup.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: A class that provides static methods for database schema inspection, e.g., retrieving table and view names.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: A class that provides methods for interacting with database objects, especially in upgrade scenarios.

methods.name: write_config_db
methods.description: Writes database configuration settings into a PHP configuration file.

methods.name: drop_tables
methods.description: Drops existing database tables related to TestLink to allow reinstallation or upgrade.

methods.name: drop_views
methods.description: Drops existing database views related to TestLink.
